mechanics.claim: Rek'Sai applies Marked as Prey to enemy champions she damages, which is required to target Void Rush.
mechanics.quote: '''Rek'Sai''' applies ''Marked as Prey'' to enemy champions she damages, lasting for 5 seconds.

mechanics.claim: Rek'Sai becomes untargetable/vanished during the cast, then dashes and deals a single instance of damage on arrival.
mechanics.quote: she slashes at the target with her claws, dealing {{as|physical damage}}, and {{tip|dash|dashes}} 125 units through them

mechanics.claim: The ability is cancelled and put on a short cooldown if the target dies, moves too far, or leaves sight during the cast or vanish.
mechanics.quote: ''Void Rush'' will be cancelled and placed on a {{sti|cd|5-second cooldown}} if the target dies or moves too far away during the cast time or while '''Rek'Sai''' is vanished, or if they are no longer in {{tip|sight}} during the cast time.

mechanics.claim: No damage is dealt if the target is untargetable when Rek'Sai reaches them.
mechanics.quote: ''Void Rush'' will not deal damage if the target is {{tip|untargetable}} by the time '''Rek'Sai''' reaches them.

mechanics.claim: If cast while burrowed, Rek'Sai automatically unburrows at the end of the cast time without triggering Unburrow's effects.
mechanics.quote: '''Rek'Sai''' will automatically {{ai|Unburrow|Rek'Sai}} at the end of Void Rush's cast time, placing {{ai|Burrow|Rek'Sai}} on a 1-second cooldown without triggering Unburrow's effects.

mechanics.claim: Rek'Sai gains displacement immunity from the start of the cast until the dash ends.
mechanics.quote: '''Rek'Sai''' gains the {{tip|displacement immunity}} from the start of the cast time, and loses it once her dash ends.
